purpose: Compare six actual Banff bases, named room categories and cooking qualifications before the tall property cards, then follow a native Expedia link for the actual date/party quote.

presentation.caption: Six Banff bases and room categories to compare
presentation.behavior: Quick table always contains all six stays. Existing filters narrow detailed cards only, stated visibly and referenced by both the table region and form. Filters do not check availability. Full SSR table/cards and native links work without JavaScript.
presentation.design: Ruled editorial table with inherited pine/gold, warm-paper and type tokens; no new font, ranking, testimonial, price badge or inventory signal.

factsAndLinks.name: Moose Hotel and Suites
factsAndLinks.sourceRoom: Superior One Bedroom Suite: separate bedroom, living room and gas fireplace. Match king or two-queen beds to your party.
factsAndLinks.sourceCooking: Suite nook with microwave, mini-fridge and sink; no full cooking kitchen.

factsAndLinks.name: Mount Royal Hotel
factsAndLinks.sourceRoom: Compare the provider’s Heritage and Centennial king or two-bed categories with the needs of your party.
factsAndLinks.sourceCooking: Plan restaurant meals; no full kitchen is established for the rooms in this comparison.
factsAndLinks.materialNoticeRepeatedBeforeQuickCta: Checked 29 October 2026: the official hotel page still reports both rooftop hot tubs closed for maintenance. Choose another fit if a soak is essential, or confirm reopening directly.

existingOfficialSources.label: Current hotel facilities and maintenance notice

factsAndLinks.name: Tunnel Mountain Resort
factsAndLinks.sourceRoom: One Bedroom Condo: queen bedroom and living-room sofa bed. Loft categories offer other bed arrangements and introduce stairs.
factsAndLinks.sourceCooking: Full kitchens in named condos; Superior Suites have kitchenettes. Match the exact category.

factsAndLinks.name: Canalta Lodge
factsAndLinks.sourceRoom: King with Sofa and Kitchen Loft adds a king bed, pull-out sofa and full-size kitchen. The other King with Sofa Loft lists a fridge and microwave.
factsAndLinks.sourceCooking: Full kitchen only in the named kitchen categories; check loft stairs and the actual layout.

factsAndLinks.name: The Juniper Hotel
factsAndLinks.sourceRoom: Deluxe King or Two Queen for a mountain-facing outlook. Standard and accessible room categories have different positions and features.
factsAndLinks.sourceCooking: Hotel-room base with bistro dining; no full kitchen is established for these room categories.

factsAndLinks.name: Fairmont Banff Springs
factsAndLinks.sourceRoom: Gatehouse Family Room has a king and twin bunks; the separate Family Suite adds a primary bedroom, built-in bunks and two bathrooms.
factsAndLinks.sourceCooking: Hotel and suite categories in this comparison do not establish a full cooking kitchen.
